name: Private jeep safari
desc: Sunrise or sunset game drive with a specialist tracker.

name: Tea estate walk & tasting
desc: Walk the plantations, then taste single-estate teas with a planter.

name: Whale & dolphin watching
desc: Boat out from Mirissa for blue whales and spinner dolphins.

name: Scenic highlands train
wiki: Nine Arches Bridge|Nine Arch Bridge, Sri Lanka|Ella, Sri Lanka
desc: The Kandy–Ella railway, widely called one of the world's great rail journeys.

name: Sri Lankan cooking class
desc: Market visit followed by a hands-on curry-and-sambol lesson.

name: Hot air balloon at dawn
desc: Drift over the ancient plains around Dambulla as the sun comes up.

name: Learn to surf
desc: Beginner-friendly breaks on the south coast, board and coach included.

name: Temple blessing ceremony
desc: A private morning blessing with a resident monk, respectfully arranged.

name: Birding at dawn
desc: Sri Lanka has 34 endemic species — go looking with a specialist guide.

name: Golden-hour photo walk
desc: A local photographer takes you to the shots the guidebooks miss.

name: Ravana Zip Lining
desc: One of Asia's longest zip line networks, strung across the Ella valley.

name: Pearl Bay Water Park
desc: Slides, wave pools and lazy rivers — a favourite cool-down for families.

name: Kandy Esala Perahera (August)
wiki: Esala Perahera|Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
desc: Torch-lit elephants, drummers and fire-dancers parade through Kandy each August.

name: Kite Surfing in Kalpitiya
desc: Steady cross-shore winds make this lagoon one of Asia's best kite spots.

name: Meet the Sea Turtles
wiki: Sea turtle|Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project
desc: Visit a coastal hatchery and wade in to meet gentle sea turtles up close.

name: Kayaking at Thalkotte Lake, Dambulla
desc: Paddle a quiet reservoir beneath Dambulla's rock outcrops at sunrise.

name: Polonnaruwa ruins day trip
desc: Cycle between 12th-century temples and reservoirs.

name: Kitulgala white-water rafting
desc: Grade 2–3 rapids on the river made famous by "Bridge on the River Kwai".

name: Negombo lagoon fishing trip
desc: Go out with local fishermen on a traditional oruwa outrigger boat.

name: Geoffrey Bawa architecture tour
desc: The tropical-modern houses and gardens of Sri Lanka's most famous architect.

name: Countryside cycling loop
desc: Paddy fields, village temples and roadside tea stalls, at a gentle pace.

name: Sinharaja rainforest hike
desc: A UNESCO rainforest reserve thick with endemic flora and fauna.

name: Udawalawe elephant park
desc: Reliable elephant herds in open grassland, plus an elephant transit home.

name: Little England walking tour
desc: Explore Nuwara Eliya's colonial racecourse, golf club and post office.

name: Sunrise yoga & meditation
desc: A quiet session overlooking rice paddies or the ocean, your choice.

name: Spice garden visit
desc: See cinnamon, pepper and cardamom growing, with an Ayurvedic tea tasting.
